must_keep.quote: In no case shall VUMC business travelers incur additional expense on behalf of the VUMC with the sole purpose of obtaining more rewards
must_keep.why: no extra expense to earn rewards

must_keep.quote: Travelers should purchase the lowest available economy class airfare that meets the business needs of the travel, except as outlined below.
must_keep.why: the lowest economy fare that meets the business needs

must_keep.quote: Travelers are responsible for ensuring that they have the necessary approval from their supervisor to take a trip prior to committing VUMC funds or incurring expenses.
must_keep.why: the supervisor's approval of the trip before committing funds

distractors.quote: Travelers may utilize travel-provider rewards related to travel (e.g., Delta Sky Miles, Marriot Rewards, etc.).
distractors.why: earning miles is allowed, but does not choose the fare

distractors.quote: Itemized receipts for all expenditures greater than or equal to $75 are required.
distractors.why: a dollar threshold for receipts, not for fares

design_notes: Line 475 lets travellers use rewards, but lines 476-478 forbid any additional expense to VUMC to obtain more rewards, and line 88 asks for the lowest economy fare. Delta is $41 dearer: American ($243).
